IRDA Integrated Grievance Management System (IGMS)
बीमा कंपनी के खिलाफ शिकायत कहाँ और कैसे करे
बीमा कंपनी के खिलाफ इरडा शिकायत  कैसे करे

===================================================
How IGMS works: Policy holder needs to login in to igms.irda.gov.in and create a profile for registering a complaint. Policy holders can register one or more complaints. Once the policy holder registers in to IGMS then details of complaint are passed on to respective insurance companies. Policy holder can see the details of the branch offices of the insurance company while registering the complaint. Policy holder receives the confirmation email after registering the complaint along with IRDAI token no which will be used by IRDAI and Insurance Company for tracking of the complaint through IGMS. A complaint registered through IGMS flows to the insurer’s system as well as the IRDAI repository. If the complainant is not satisfied with the resolution provided by Insurer, he/she can escalate the complaint for a review by IRDAI for a potential violation of Regulations. All the transactions between the Insurer, Insured and Remarks by IRDAI are visible to the complainant.
